Durations are in working days: Monday to Friday, except the shaded company holidays. Every link is finish-to-start, and a task starts on the first working day after all of its predecessors finish. Which tasks have zero total slack, meaning any delay to them delays the project finish? List their IDs in increasing order, separated by commas.

Think step by step. Then end your reply with one final line in exactly this form:
FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

## Reading the chart

Working days run Monday to Friday, skipping the holidays Thu 11/26, Fri 11/27, Fri 12/25 and Fri 1/1. Reading each bar's start and finish, with the arrows as links:

| ID | Task | Working span | Main link |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Kickoff meeting | Mon 11/16 | start |
| 2 | Site survey | Tue 11/17 | 1 |
| 3 | Permit application | Tue 11/17 | 1 |
| 4 | Electrical rough-in | Wed 11/18 – Wed 11/25 | 3 |
| 5 | HVAC ductwork | Wed 11/18 – Tue 11/24 | 2 |
| 6 | Framing | Wed 11/25 – Tue 12/8 | 5 |
| 7 | Painting | Wed 12/9 – Mon 12/14 | 6 |
| 8 | Drywall | Mon 11/30 – Wed 12/9 | 4 |
| 9 | Fire alarm install | Mon 11/30 – Mon 12/7 | 4 |
| 10 | Ceiling grid | Tue 12/8 – Thu 12/17 | 9 |
| 11 | Lighting fixtures | Tue 12/15 – Thu 12/24 | 7 |
| 12 | Flooring | Thu 12/10 – Wed 12/16 | 8 |
| 13 | IT cabling | Thu 12/17 – Thu 12/24 | 12 |
| 14 | Signage | Mon 12/28 | 13 |
| 15 | Furniture delivery | Fri 12/18 – Tue 12/22 | 10 |
| 16 | Handover to tenant | Tue 12/29 | 14, 15, 11 |

The project finishes Tue 12/29.

## Tracing zero-slack tasks

Working backward from task 16, which must start Tue 12/29 (the day after the Mon 12/28 finish of task 14):

- **Task 14** starts Mon 12/28 only because task 13 finishes Thu 12/24, the last working day before it. Task 13 therefore has no slack.
- **Task 13** starts Thu 12/17 right after task 12 finishes Wed 12/16. Task 12 is critical.
- **Task 12** starts Thu 12/10 right after task 8 finishes Wed 12/9. Task 8 is critical.
- **Task 8** starts Mon 11/30 right after task 4 finishes Wed 11/25 (the holidays fall in between). Task 4 is critical.
- **Task 4** starts Wed 11/18 right after task 3 finishes Tue 11/17. Task 3 is critical.
- **Task 3** starts Tue 11/17 right after task 1 finishes Mon 11/16. Task 1 is critical.

## Checking the other branches

- **Task 11** finishes Thu 12/24, but task 16 could tolerate it finishing as late as Mon 12/28. That gives it one working day of slack, so it is not critical.
- **Tasks 6, 7** feed task 11, so they inherit that same one-day slack and are not critical.
- **Tasks 2 and 5** feed task 6, so they also carry one day of slack.
- **Task 15** finishes Tue 12/22, far earlier than needed, so it has large slack.
- **Tasks 9 and 10** lead to task 15 and also have large slack.

The zero-slack chain is 1 → 3 → 4 → 8 → 12 → 13 → 14 → 16.

FINAL ANSWER: 1, 3, 4, 8, 12, 13, 14, 16
